prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Create ONE production city-map building sprite for tianshu, early-to-middle Qing Jiangnan region, 17th–18th century. The supplied Song Jiangnan image is a REFERENCE for the realistic material detail density and camera, NOT an edit target: generate an entirely new building of the stated type. Orthographic camera yaw45 elevation30; 2:1 dimetric ground projection, BOTH ground axes slopes precisely +0.5 and -0.5, verticals upright, parallel edges, NO perspective. Original South-facing entrance faces screen LOWER LEFT. True transparent RGBA background, all subject and short contact shadow completely inside canvas with at least 10% transparent margins. Very thin flat rectangular ground footprint with all three front ground corners clear; no thick diorama plinth. Realistic ancient architecture sprite, softly weathered off-white lime plaster, charcoal gray small fired clay roof tiles, gray brick/stone bases, dark timber and fine wood lattice windows. Modest Qing-style brick gate surrounds and restrained small carved trim; no ubiquitous imperial gilding, no giant ornamental roof curls. Light screen UPPER LEFT, small soft contact shadow screen LOWER RIGHT. NO sky, horizon, landscape, road outside footprint, humans, animals, calligraphy, labels, pseudo-writing, numbers, signage, watermark, checkers, plastic, cartoon, modern objects. This is an original generic game composite inspired by regional surviving Ming/Qing architectural forms, NOT a restoration of a named monument. Subject: Qing Jiangnan escort agency / freight courtyard, low main timber warehouse and office at rear, one smaller side shed, enclosing limewashed walls and modest gray-brick gate, a few closed wooden freight chests and a two-wheel timber handcart tucked against the side, compact paved open yard. No shields, weapons or text banners, no imperial roof or official drum. Dark timber lattice doors and restrained carved brick entrance. Footprint EAST-WEST15 metres, NORTH-SOUTH12 metres, projected width-edge:depth-edge ratio exactly15:12. Very thin rectangular footprint, all three front ground corners clear.Critical revision for selected candidate: remove ALL broad haze, colored halo, ambient ground blur and large cast shadow. Exterior outside the thin footprint must have alpha exactly zero, except a tiny 2-pixel antialiased edge and a very short contact shadow. Image is an isolated transparent game sprite, not a miniature rendered against studio background. Footprint east-west edge slopes +0.500, north-south edge slopes -0.500, no elevated perspective camera. Front corner centered slightly right as required by15:12 footprint. NO vegetation at all.
